note: zuzu-shifting-lands t-033: one scene brief per V6 card (kind_robots utils/shiftingLands/authoredDecksV6.json), written with the card. Every object the title names must be visible and countable; the traveler is out of frame or seen from behind, never given a face, species or gender; no lettering.

cards.title: The Moved Fence Posts
cards.brief: Pre-dawn blue light over a small, dry frontier orchard. A gaunt rabbit farmer in patched overalls tamps the last of four freshly reset fence posts into hard ground, shovel in hand, old holes open behind him. Two small children with tin buckets crouch at a muddy seep spring just inside the new line. A dark farmhouse sits up the slope. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the frame edge, seen from behind. Guilty, quiet mood.

cards.title: The Collector's Ledger
cards.brief: Late-morning glare on a weathered farmhouse porch. A thin weasel clerk in a dusty frock coat sits on the step with one open ledger across his knees, pen raised, a saddled mule tied at the rail. In the doorway, a worn otter farm wife stands beside three bulging sacks of seed corn, arms folded. Cracked fields stretch behind. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Sober, uneasy mood.

cards.title: The Three-Wheeled Wagon
cards.brief: Hot late afternoon at a sagging border fence. One battered covered wagon tilts on its three remaining wheels, the fourth wheel broken into spokes in the ditch. In its narrow shade sit two tired possum parents, a grandmother, and three small children. At the orchard gate a stern badger farmer holds a rifle across his chest, apple trees behind him. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands between them at the frame edge, seen from behind. Strained, dusty mood.

cards.title: A Tithe Basket at the Gate
cards.brief: Overcast noon at a split-rail farm gate. Two mounted coyote road wardens in faded blue coats, clubs at their belts, wait beside one large empty wicker tithe basket set in the dust. The older warden is gaunt and weary. Behind the fence, three young raccoon children cling to the rails before a small orchard. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak approaches along the track at the frame edge, seen from behind. Grim, hungry mood.

cards.title: The Noon Water Line
cards.brief: Harsh noon sun over a stone well with a long wooden trough. A ragged line of farmers stretches out of the shade. Near the front, a desperate goat farmer hauls one swaying, sick ox by its halter. Further back, a young hare mother rocks a swaddled baby. At the well, an old tortoise keeper ladles a single tin cup. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands in the line, seen from behind. Parched, tense mood.

cards.title: The Dowser's Hazel Fork
cards.brief: Hazy afternoon on cracked ground beyond a low stone well. A lean jackrabbit dowser in split boots holds one forked hazel stick out before him, its point dipping toward a marker stone. Three farm families of mixed species trail behind at a hopeful distance with shovels. A line of scrubby mesquite runs across a far slope. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the frame edge, seen from behind. Hopeful, doubtful mood.

cards.title: A Padlock on the Well Lid
cards.brief: Flat evening light over an old stone well capped with one riveted iron lid, a single heavy padlock hanging from its hasp. A broad young boar sits on the rim with a tin cup and a cudgel across his knees. A few paces off, a thin donkey family waits beside a cart of empty barrels. Dust hangs in the air. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Hard, uneasy mood.

cards.title: A Ribbon on the Windlass
cards.brief: Dusk at a weathered stone well with a wooden windlass and crank. One faded blue ribbon is knotted tight around the crank handle, its ends fraying in the breeze. A middle-aged mouse mother in a patched shawl sits on the rim beside it, staring down a long road toward a distant lantern-lit mission wall. Empty buckets rest at her feet. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Aching, quiet mood.

cards.title: Bread Under the Long Table
cards.brief: Warm lamplight in a whitewashed refectory. One long plank table runs its length, lined with tired refugee families and baskets of counted loaves. A small, thin squirrel boy tucks a loaf of bread into his shirt beneath the table edge. At the end of the table, a stern hooded sister has just turned to see it. A painted rule is lettered above the door. A lone traveler sits beside the boy, seen from behind. Hushed, taut mood.

cards.title: The Refuge Lantern at Midnight
cards.brief: Midnight on an adobe mission wall in blowing dust. One iron refuge lantern burns low on a hook above the gate, its flame guttering. Below, through a small back gate, a covered cart pulled by a dark mule rolls out without a light, its canvas bulging with small shapes. On a bench beneath the lantern, an elderly owl sister sleeps under a blanket. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands beside the lantern, seen from behind. Eerie, still mood.

cards.title: The Guest Book on the Lectern
cards.brief: Cool morning light in a mission entry hall with a tiled floor. One thick leather guest book lies open on a carved wooden lectern, columns of names in many hands, a long column of blank lines down one side. A smiling ferret secretary in a pale habit holds out a dipped pen. A wooden door to an inner corridor stands shut behind her. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the lectern, seen from behind. Polite, unsettling mood.

cards.title: The Infirmary's Last Cot
cards.brief: Dim candlelight in a narrow mission infirmary: six empty cots, and on the last cot a feverish ox drover shivering under a gray blanket. A young deer nursing sister in a white apron stands between him and one heavy locked door marked with a carved child's cradle. An empty medicine shelf hangs on the wall. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak kneels at the cot, seen from behind. Anxious, hushed mood.

cards.title: One Too Many Aboard
cards.brief: A flat river ferry riding dangerously low in brown water at hazy midday, deck boards awash. Ten passengers crowd the benches, among them an old woman half-risen with a bundle of quilts and a grandson gripping her sleeve. Three oil casks are lashed at the stern. The pilot, pole in hand, counts heads. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak, the eleventh, stands at the frame edge seen from behind. Tense, heavy mood.

cards.title: The Smuggler's Mirror
cards.brief: Gray-gold dawn on a reedy riverbank. A young woman in a ferry hand's apron presses one cracked hand mirror into the open palm of a lone traveler in a dusty cloak, seen from behind at the frame edge. Upriver, a low raft stacked with flour sacks waits in the mist. Across the water stands a small toll watch post with a single lantern still burning. Hushed, conspiratorial mood.

cards.title: A Barge Flying Yellow
cards.brief: A weathered river barge at anchor off a plank dock, one yellow rag tied to its mast and hanging limp in the heat. On the dock a landing man holds a long boat hook ready. A thin figure leans over the barge rail, reaching out. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the dock's end, seen from behind, a borrowed skiff and water skins nearby. Harsh noon light and a fearful mood.

cards.title: The Swimmer's Purse
cards.brief: A fast brown river channel between two wooden piers in hard afternoon light. From the far pier hangs one leather purse on a cord. On the near bank a thin father stands barefoot beside his boots while his three children watch from the mud. Ferry crewmen lean on the pier rail laying bets. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the frame edge, seen from behind. Reckless, uneasy mood.

cards.title: The Notice on the Post
cards.brief: A ferry landing in pale morning light, a tall mooring post in the foreground with one paper notice nailed to it, corners curling. Travelers with packs turn away from it toward dry hills. A young ferry hand lingers nearby with a hammer in his belt, avoiding every eye. Across the river the far bank looks busy and ordinary. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak reads the notice, seen from behind. Quietly suspicious mood.

cards.title: Chalk Prices on the Slate
cards.brief: Interior of a dim frontier trading post, sunlight slanting through dust. Behind the counter hangs one slate board covered in chalked prices, one number freshly smudged and rewritten, the trader licking his thumb beside it. Flour sacks slump against the counter. A woman with a baby on her hip waits in line. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the counter, seen from behind at the frame edge. Wary, transactional mood.

cards.title: The Widow's Debt for Sale
cards.brief: A crowded trading post room mid-auction, warm stove light and heavy silence. On the counter lies one folded sheet of paper under the trader's raised hand. A land agent in a good coat lifts a finger to bid. By the door a widow in an apron stands with her hands knotted together. Onlookers line the shelves. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands among them at the frame edge, seen from behind.

cards.title: The Forged Water Ticket
cards.brief: A stone cistern beside a frontier trading post under a white-hot sky. A clerk at a small table holds up one square tin water ticket, plainly hammered from a can lid, and turns questioningly toward a lone traveler in a dusty cloak at the frame edge, seen from behind. A barefoot boy of about ten clutches an empty jug. Thirsty people queue behind him. Dry, tense mood.

cards.title: Fever Bark at Triple Price
cards.brief: Inside a lamplit trading post, a high shelf holds one glass jar of curled fever bark. Below it the trader chalks a tripled price on the counter slate, his other hand resting near a cudgel. A tired mother clutches her shawl, pleading. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Dust hangs in the light, and the mood is sour and cornered.

cards.title: The Deserter Behind the Bins
cards.brief: Behind a frontier trading post in late afternoon, three tall wooden grain bins stand in a row. Between them crouches a boy in a torn warden's coat, knees drawn to his chest. The trader leans in from the corner of the building, pointing and smiling. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Long shadows, drifting dust, and dusk coming on.

cards.title: Two Maps, One Channel
cards.brief: A fresh water channel cuts across cracked delta mud in bright morning light. On either side stands a thirsty homestead family, each holding up one hand-drawn map toward the middle: two maps in all, visibly different. Children peer from behind their parents. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands between the families, seen from behind. Parched, uneasy mood.

cards.title: A Riverboat on Dry Sand
cards.brief: A paddle-wheel riverboat sits upright on endless cracked sand, its wheel caked with dried mud, no water in sight. Its captain stands on deck under a faded awning, arms folded. Four gaunt crew members sit in the strip of shade beneath the hull. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak approaches from the frame edge, seen from behind. Blinding afternoon glare, heat shimmer, and a melancholy mood.

cards.title: The Dowser's Forked Stick
cards.brief: A cracked, salt-crusted delta in late gold light. A dowser walks with one forked willow stick held out before her, its tip dipping toward the ground. A line of thirsty homesteaders carrying shovels follows at a respectful distance. Patches of thinner, darker crust show where she steps. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the frame edge, seen from behind. Hopeful and doubtful at once.

cards.title: A Dam of Broken Wagons
cards.brief: A trickling stream blocked by a crude dam of five broken wagon beds stacked and packed with mud. Behind it, squatter children splash in a small brown pond beside a ragged camp. Downstream, brown dying reeds stretch away. A delta farmer grips a crowbar beside a lone traveler in a dusty cloak, seen from behind at the frame edge. Hot, still air and a divided mood.

cards.title: The Patrol's Strongbox
cards.brief: A sun-bleached dry channel in the delta under stark midday light. Half buried in silt lie a capsized skiff, one iron strongbox with a rusted lock, and four rusted patrol badges in a row. A scrap of oilcloth listing names is nailed to the skiff's ribs. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak kneels at the frame edge, seen from behind. Quiet, mournful mood.

cards.title: Six Tally Sticks
cards.brief: Late afternoon outside a rough plank foreman's shed at a quarry rim, red dust in slanting light. Six split tally sticks hang from a single iron nail by the door, notches visible. A young marmot laborer holds out her matching half; a heavy foreman stands in the doorway, arms folded. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak, seen from behind at the frame edge, compares the sticks. Mood: quiet, tense arithmetic.

cards.title: Four Lamps on the Ledge
cards.brief: Night in a terraced stone quarry under a black sky full of stars. Four oil lamps burn in a row along a narrow ledge, each lighting a hollow-cheeked debtor swinging a hammer at an unpropped shelf of rock. A stocky badger crew boss stands near the nearest lamp, arms crossed. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the foot of the ledge at the frame edge. Mood: weary, precarious, lit gold against cold blue.

cards.title: Three Bottles of Tonic
cards.brief: Overcast noon at a quarry rim, pale dust hanging in the air. Three corked brown bottles of tonic stand on a flat stone slab behind a smiling peddler in a patched coat. A line of thin quarry cutters waits, coughing into their sleeves, one old cutter bent nearly double. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind, watching. Mood: hollow, pitiful, quietly wrong.

cards.title: The Bell in the Sealed Adit
cards.brief: Harsh morning light on a quarry wall where a tunnel mouth has collapsed into a slope of broken rock. One brass bell hangs from a timber crossbar above the rubble, its rope running down between the stones and pulled taut. A thin company clerk holds an open ledger nearby. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak kneels at the rubble's edge, seen from behind. Mood: urgent, haunted, hopeful.

cards.title: The Company Store Scales
cards.brief: Inside a cramped company store at a quarry rim, dusty light through a shuttered window. A set of brass balance scales sits on the counter with two black iron weights beside it and a scoop of flour in one pan. A tired hare storekeeper with a bandaged hand stands behind it, a chalked debt board on the wall. A laborer's wife clutches a sack; a lone traveler in a dusty cloak waits at the frame edge.

cards.title: The Cart in the Dry Wash
cards.brief: Stormy afternoon in a sandy dry wash between red canyon walls. One wooden cart with a snapped axle sits tilted in the wash bed, piled with bedding, pots and seed sacks. A lean pronghorn father grips its wheel while his wife and two small children stand nearby. Black thunderheads loom over a distant mesa upstream. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: dread, stubborn love.

cards.title: Five Fallen Cairns
cards.brief: Bright windy morning on a narrow canyon ledge trail. Five toppled cairns lie along the path as scattered heaps of flat stones, some tumbling down the slope. A ragged guide in worn boots sits beside the last heap, two small children in the shade of a boulder behind her. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak approaches from the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: suspicion and poverty.

cards.title: The Raider Beneath the Arch
cards.brief: A natural sandstone arch on a bare mesa top under a purple storm sky, lightning forking in the distance. Beneath the arch lies a wounded coyote raider, one leg splinted crookedly, his head resting on a pair of leather saddlebags. Rain sheets in from the left. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge just outside the shelter, seen from behind. Mood: wary, cramped, charged.

cards.title: The Writ and the Runaways
cards.brief: Hard noon light in a narrow red canyon. Two runaway debtors, a mother and her grown son, crouch in a dark vertical crack in the canyon wall, eyes wide. Around a bend strides a bounty hunter in a long coat, holding up one unrolled writ with a red wax seal. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands between them, seen from behind at the frame edge. Mood: a held breath.

cards.title: The Shrine at Whistling Notch
cards.brief: Windswept dusk at a narrow slot cutting through a mesa, sand streaming through it sideways. At the slot's mouth stands a waist-high shrine of piled flat stones holding tin cups of water and bread crusts. An old ewe in a shawl sits beside it, lips moving as she counts. A raven perches on top. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, cloak whipping. Mood: mournful, roaring.

cards.title: One Pot, Seven Bowls
cards.brief: Firelit night under a canyon overhang, rain falling beyond the circle of light. One soot-black cooking pot hangs over the fire; seven wooden bowls stand in a row on a flat rock, half filled with bean stew. A weary cook holds the ladle. A quarry widow and her small son stand dripping at the light's edge. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak sits at the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: warmth with a hard edge.

cards.title: Dice for an Indenture
cards.brief: Night at a canyon campfire, sparks rising against a striped rock wall. A smirking labor recruiter kneels on a blanket with three bone dice mid-roll and one signed indenture paper weighted by a stone. A thin young drifter sits hunched beside him, watching the dice. Other campers look on from the shadows. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak sits across the blanket at the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: sly, desperate.

cards.title: A Letter for the Warden
cards.brief: Evening at a canyon camp fire, red cliffs fading to violet above. A frail old woman in a heavy shawl holds out one folded letter sealed with a blob of dark wax. Behind her, a camp scribe sits on a crate with a pen and inkpot. Firelight warms her face. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak reaches for the letter from the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: tender, weighted, private.

cards.title: The Thief at the Picket Post
cards.brief: Cold stormy night at the ragged edge of a canyon camp, fires glowing behind. A young otter sits tied by the wrists to a single wooden picket post, a burlap sack of meal spilled at his feet, rain glistening on him. He stares off toward a black canyon mouth. A guard dozes nearby wrapped in a blanket. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: bleak, uneasy.

cards.title: Two Piles of Voting Stones
cards.brief: Twilight in a deep canyon camp, a thunderstorm flickering over the mesa rim far above. On a woven blanket sit two piles of voting stones, one white and one black, exactly matched. A broad camp boss holds out a single stone; anxious families crowd around with packed bundles. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak reaches for it at the frame edge, seen from behind. Mood: suspense, heavy air.

cards.title: The Fortieth Stone
cards.brief: A wind-torn cave mouth at dusk, sleet slanting across grey rock. A crow-witch in a patched shawl sits cross-legged at the threshold, a clay bowl in her lap holding thirty-nine river stones, a fortieth stone raised in her hand. Behind her, the black throat of the cave. In the foreground a young mother hunches over a swaddled baby; a lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Cold blue light, held breath.

cards.title: No Fever Past the Rope
cards.brief: The cave mouth in heavy rain, lit by one sputtering lantern. A single rope is strung across the entrance at waist height, a dented tin cup hanging from its middle. A tired sentry with a staff stands behind the rope. Outside it, a feverish carter slumps against the rock, flushed and sweating, while his small daughter lifts the cup to his mouth. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Grim, wet, quiet.

cards.title: A Loom Too Wide
cards.brief: A narrow cave mouth under a bruised sky, hail streaking down the ridge behind. A wooden handcart is wedged in the gap, a single upright weaver's loom lashed on top, its beam half-wound with patterned cloth. A stubborn grandmother grips the loom's frame; two small boys, blue-lipped with cold, push at the cart. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Hard white light, stubborn love.

cards.title: The Creditor's Ledger
cards.brief: Rain at the cave mouth, a canvas-covered wagon pulled up on the muddy slope. A weary storekeeper in a dripping hat sits on an overturned crate beneath the overhang, one thick ledger open on his knee, its pages crowded with names and crossed-out sums. A pale woman's hand shows at the wagon's canvas flap. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Grey light, honest grievance on every side.

cards.title: The Mule That Fears the Dark
cards.brief: A cave mouth battered by hail, white pellets bouncing off black rock. An old packer leans back on a halter rope with both hands, face wet. One stubborn grey mule plants its hooves at the edge of the cave's shadow, two bulging flour sacks strapped across its back, welts on its flank. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Cold, loud, desperate.

cards.title: The Guttering Debt Candle
cards.brief: A stone niche in a cavern wall, ringed by many small candles in the dim distance, but the focus is one guttering stub of tallow, a man's name scratched into its base. A girl of about twelve kneels before it, cupping both hands around the failing flame. A thin clerk with a wax tablet stands behind her. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Warm amber against deep black, quiet dread.

cards.title: The Drip-Pool Ration
cards.brief: A low stone hollow lit by tallow lamps. One shallow drip-pool gleams in the floor, water falling into it drop by drop from a stalactite. A silent line of refugees holds dented tin cups. At the passage mouth, two stern oath-keepers grip a thin newcomer by the arms; a sick woman lies on a blanket nearby. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Cool green-grey light, tense stillness.

cards.title: The Name Jar
cards.brief: A shadowed corner of a stone hollow, lamplight pooling on a salt barrel where a crow-witch sits in layered black shawls. Beside her stands one clay jar sealed with yellow wax, and a stack of folded wool blankets. A line of ragged refugees waits; at its front an old man presses his knuckles to his mouth, torn. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Hushed, uncanny, sad.

cards.title: Loaves Against the Spring
cards.brief: The warmest corner of a stone hollow, a squat clay oven glowing orange. Beside it, four round brown loaves cool on a slab of slate. A broad-shouldered baker with floured forearms stands with one hand on the hollow's smooth oath-stone. Refugees wait in a loose line, faces lit by the oven. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Warm light, hungry eyes.

cards.title: Salt for the Burial
cards.brief: A small stone niche lit by one oil lamp. A woman's body lies shrouded on a bier of dark slate. Her husband, a miner in a dust-grey coat, kneels and pours a thin white line of salt from a leather pouch over the shroud. Against the rock wall sit three children, watching the pouch empty. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Still, reverent, heavy.

cards.title: Arrows in Children's Chalk
cards.brief: An underground crossroads where four tunnels meet, lit by a single hanging lantern. The rock walls are covered in white chalk arrows, small suns and stick-figure dogs drawn at a child's height. Several arrows point into a dark passage where black water gleams and rises. Two sets of small footprints lead into it. A frantic mother cups her hands to call. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Urgent, cold.

cards.title: The Bone Compass
cards.brief: A crow-witch in a tattered feathered cloak sits on a stone ledge under a hanging lantern where dark tunnels meet. In her lap rests a round compass carved from pale bone, its needle a single black quill. Beside her, a small clay dish holds a bread crust, a dark smear of dried blood and a curl of bark with writing on it. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Eerie, intimate.

cards.title: The Surveyor's Tally Book
cards.brief: An underground crossroads lit by a surveyor's brass lamp. A neat territorial surveyor in a long coat holds one open tally book and a pencil, a patient mule beside him laden with grain sacks. Behind him, the mouths of side tunnels are dark, with a few frightened eyes glinting from within. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Sober, uneasy, two kinds of hunger.

cards.title: A Guide Who Never Came
cards.brief: A cramped underground crossroads, a tiny fire of twigs flickering in a ring of stones. A family of five huddles around it: a weary mother, three children wrapped in one blanket, and a father holding up a single brass token stamped with a crow. Four tunnel mouths gape in the dark behind them. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Small warm light, enormous dark, waiting.

cards.title: Vows by the Last Lamp
cards.brief: A narrow side tunnel lit by one small oil lamp set on a flat rock, its flame low. A young refugee couple in patched clothes hold hands on one side of the lamp. Across from them stands the bride's father, arms folded, jaw set. Dim figures of the camp listen at the edges of the light. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Tender, tense, golden against black.

cards.title: The Handcart and the Loom
cards.brief: Dusk on a black obsidian road under drifting ash. At the tail of a ragged refugee column, an elderly badger weaver pushes one wooden handcart with a visibly wobbling wheel; one wooden weaving loom is lashed upright on top of it. Ahead, the column's lanterns trail toward distant orange camp watchfires. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge beside the cart, seen from behind. Grey, heavy, tender mood.

cards.title: The Deserter's Cage
cards.brief: Harsh noon on the obsidian road, heat shimmer rising off black stones. One iron cage hangs from one wooden post; inside crouches a young hare deserter, squinting. One iron key hangs on a nail just beyond his reach, under one painted wooden board. Far behind on the road, a single rider's dust plume. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak, seen from behind at the frame edge, lifts a waterskin. Bleached, thirsty, uneasy mood.

cards.title: The Press-Gang at the Milestone
cards.brief: Midday beside one cracked stone milestone on a black road. A burly gorilla sergeant in a stained coat holds a rope tied around a young otter's wrists; a barefoot otter girl clutches the boy's sleeve, crying, beside one small family cart. Two more press-gang members wait with coils of rope. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the frame edge, back to the viewer. Tense, sun-bleached light.

cards.title: The Mule on the Glass
cards.brief: A field of broken black obsidian glittering under a low white sun. One pack mule lies on its side, forelegs cut, two heavy leather panniers still strapped to it. A weathered coyote peddler kneels at its head with one hand on its neck, a knife at her belt. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind. Quiet, grieving, merciless light.

cards.title: The Fork in the Black Glass
cards.brief: Elevated view at smoky amber evening: a black road splits into two forks around one glowing orange tongue of fresh lava. The left fork curves wide toward a burned hamlet, where a small figure on one roof waves one white cloth. The right fork runs straight across glossy new black glass with thin steam rising. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the split, seen from behind. Choice-heavy, hushed mood.

cards.title: The Short Ration Line
cards.brief: Grey dawn in a fortified camp yard ringed by sharpened log walls. A heavyset boar quartermaster ladles porridge from one black iron kettle beside a small table with one open ledger. A long line of ragged refugees stretches out of frame; at its end, a mother with three small children turns away. A gorilla guard shoves a thin man holding a second bowl. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands in the line, seen from behind.

cards.title: Two Cots, One Draught
cards.brief: Inside a lamp-lit canvas infirmary tent. A tired raccoon surgeon holds up one small glass vial of amber draught between two cots: on the left, a young fevered fox sentry; on the right, a chained, wary jackal raider. A stern gorilla commander stands at the tent flap. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak at the frame edge, seen from behind, is the one they all look toward. Warm lamplight, cold dilemma.

cards.title: The Stockade at Dawn
cards.brief: Pale dawn over a log stockade in a fortified camp, watchfire smoke drifting. A chained wolf raider stands on one wooden platform beneath one empty noose hanging from a beam. A crowd of grieving refugees gathers below, faces hard; a gorilla commander with a sabre waits at the steps. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak climbs the steps at the frame edge, seen from behind. Cold, hushed light; no violence shown.

cards.title: The Rope Ladder at Night
cards.brief: Night at the barred wooden gate of a fortified camp, torches burning along the parapet. One coiled rope ladder hangs on a peg beside the parapet; a grizzled gorilla gate sergeant stands with arms crossed. Below the wall, a crowd of refugees presses against the gate, and a mouse mother lifts one sleeping child toward the torchlight. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands on the parapet, seen from behind. Orange torchlight against deep blue dark.

cards.title: The Dead Sentry's Boots
cards.brief: Behind a camp armory at dusk, lantern-lit. Three soldiers, a gorilla, a boar and a weasel, crouch at an upturned crate holding two bone dice and one pair of worn leather boots as the stake. A few steps away a body lies under one grey blanket. A barefoot young ferret girl waits by a ditch, arms wrapped around herself. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak watches from the frame edge, back to the viewer. Bitter mood.

cards.title: The Wooden Horse at the Gate
cards.brief: Late golden afternoon at the base of a towering black threshold wall with a great gate. A gaunt rabbit woman sits against the wall, turning one small carved wooden horse in her hands, eyes distant. Far below, a black road winds back to faint camp smoke. Ash drifts through the light. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak crouches at the frame edge, seen from behind. Sorrowful, quiet mood.

cards.title: The Creditor's Tally Sticks
cards.brief: Cold grey light before the last gate. A sharp-eyed vulture creditor sits at one folding table holding a bundle of notched wooden tally sticks, one split stick laid out as two halves before her. A tired beaver family stands opposite: father, mother and three children, with two small coats folded on the table. One mule is tethered behind her. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak waits in line, seen from behind.

cards.title: The Charcoal Portraits
cards.brief: A checkpoint at the threshold gate under an ash-grey sky. Three gorilla wardens in long ash-grey coats; the lead warden holds up a thick sheaf of charcoal portrait sketches, the top drawing facing out. Two wardens grip a frightened young lynx by the arms. A queue of refugees waits behind them. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands in the queue at the frame edge, seen from behind. Stark, smudged light.

cards.title: The Sentry Without Relief
cards.brief: Dawn wind at the black threshold wall. One ancient, gaunt goat sentry stands rigid at his post in a heavily patched coat, one spear grounded beside him, ribs showing through his shirt. Far below, cookfire smoke rises from the fortified camp. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands before him, seen from behind at the frame edge, holding out bread. Faded, dignified, lonely mood.

cards.title: The Smuggler's Side Door
cards.brief: Cold blue dusk at the shadowed base of the immense threshold wall, far from its main gate. One narrow iron-banded side door stands half open; a lean fox smuggler leans in the doorway with a lantern and a sack of traded food. Beside the door, a refugee mouse family, two parents and three children, sits on a blanket with nothing. A lone traveler in a dusty cloak stands at the frame edge, seen from behind.
